idea-plugin.name: CBPR+ Structured Address Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Find the ISO 20022 postal addresses your correspondent bank will repair by hand, before you send the message

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → CBPR+ Structured Address Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 9 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/cbpr-address-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/cbpr-address-lint

action.text: CBPR+ Structured Address Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run CBPR+ Structured Address Lint on the file in the editor
